# Juskoe

> Juskoe is a system-wide AI voice dictation and voice-to-text desktop application for
> Windows and macOS. Speak naturally in any application and Juskoe converts your speech into
> formatted, polished text at your cursor.

Note: "Juskoe" is not related to the Filipino/Tagalog slang expression "jusko"/"juskoe"
(an exclamation derived from "Diyos ko", meaning "my God"). Juskoe is the name of this
software product, developed by 16xStudios.

## What Juskoe Is

- A desktop application (not a web app, not a browser extension) for Windows and macOS.
- Works system-wide: any text field in any application (email clients, IDEs, chat apps,
  word processors, browsers) can receive dictated text.
- Converts speech to text locally, then optionally routes text through an AI engine for
  formatting, grammar correction, or rewriting depending on which mode is active.
- Built and maintained by 16xStudios.

## Modes

Juskoe has three primary dictation modes, plus a fourth transform mode:

- **AI Mode (hotkey F7)** — speak an intent ("write a professional email about Q4 results")
  and Juskoe generates fully formatted output pasted at the cursor. Used for drafting emails,
  messages, code snippets, prompts, and structured plans.
- **Grammar Mode (hotkey F8)** — speak naturally, including filler words ("umm", "uhh"), and
  Juskoe outputs clean, grammatically correct text with fixed spelling, punctuation, and
  capitalization.
- **Notes Mode (hotkey F9)** — speak freely to capture ideas, to-do lists, or meeting notes;
  output is formatted into readable notes and saved to a local notes library (cloud sync on
  Pro).
- **Rewrite Mode (select text + F7)** — select existing text in any app, then speak an
  instruction ("make this more professional", "translate to Spanish", "summarize in 3
  bullets") to transform the selection in place.

## Key Features

- Custom dictionaries (user-added words/names/jargon)
- Text snippets (saved reusable text blocks)
- Local notes library
- App-aware formatting (output style adapts to the target application)
- Multi-language speech recognition
- Cloud sync of dictionary, snippets, notes, and settings (Pro only)

## Pricing

Juskoe has two plans:

- **Free — $0/forever.** 25 total uses/day (10 AI Mode uses via F7, 15 Grammar Mode uses via
  F8), 200 combined uses/month. Includes local dictionary, local snippets, local notes,
  app-aware formatting, and limited prompt generation. No cloud sync.
- **Pro — $10/month (or $8/month billed annually).** Unlimited AI Mode and Grammar Mode
  usage, longer/more detailed outputs, priority processing, cloud sync across devices for
  dictionary/snippets/notes, higher-quality rewrites, advanced prompt generation, and early
  access to new features.

Pricing in India is shown in INR (₹359/month, ₹300/month billed annually) based on device
timezone.

## Supported Platforms

- Windows 10 and later
- macOS 12 and later
